verdict_reason: P3-A stop-early condition met: the installed torchrl 0.14.1 AsyncBatchedCollector enforces a strict observation->action client contract with no hook to the worker-local Rust engine, so a P1 staged conditional packet cannot be produced on its acting path. One focused compatibility correction was attempted and failed. A P3-F fallback ADR is proposed and requires user approval; a fallback-only result would be PARTIAL against the preferred integration requirement, not PASS.
gpu_device_used: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (8188 MiB, driver 610.88, capability 8.9)
collector_implementation_path: P3-I blocked; P3-F fallback proposed and NOT approved

p3a_evidence.collector_contract: client(observation) -> action, then env.step_and_maybe_reset(action_td); one exchange per env step
p3a_evidence.policy_client_module_documented_as: remote transport client that carries no lifecycle rights
p3a_evidence.probe_1: constructor succeeds; next(iter(col)) raises RuntimeError from a worker thread
p3a_evidence.probe_2: process-local env registry populated in factory, but the client is never invoked (no CLIENT INVOKED log)
p3a_evidence.probe_3: direct P2 contract check passes: obs batch [1], packet batch [1], action (1,2,4,6)
p3a_evidence.observed_exception: Received a new batch size torch.Size([1, 1]) with an existing batch_size torch.Size([1]) in a lazy TD

proposed_adr.summary: Narrow TorchRL-compatible actor loop owning the staged protocol, using the real InferenceServer + ProcessSlotTransport, emitting ordinary TensorDict transitions; no TorchRL fork.
proposed_adr.gate_consequence: A fallback-only result is PARTIAL against the preferred integration requirement unless the user approves the ADR.

not_done: P3-B central CUDA B>=2 batching: not started (depends on an approved acting path)
deliberately_not_done: Did not fork or patch TorchRL
Did not write a generic Collector replacement
Did not use a dummy or random policy to force a G3-A pass
Did not weaken G3-A or any acceptance criterion
Did not move legality into Python
limitations: Only P3-0 preflight and P3-A compatibility investigation were completed
No P3 source code was written because the acting path is unapproved
The batch-size incompatibility might be separately fixable, but fixing it would not give the client access to the Rust candidate API, so G3-A would still be unsatisfiable through that path
The P3 verdict is the design's specified outcome for a fundamental compatibility failure, not a judgement on P1/P2 correctness
